# PayProbe

**Open-source regression testing platform for payment terminal ecosystems**

[![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-blue.svg)](https://github.com/pay-probe/payprobe/blob/main/LICENSE)
[![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/pay-probe/payprobe?style=social)](https://github.com/pay-probe/payprobe)

Automated three-phase regression testing for POS terminals, payment servers, HSM, Core Banking, and Switch systems.

**50,000 concurrent connections · 10,000 operations/sec · Angular portal · Docker-native**
